<!-- pr-reviewer: 061f7855596f16980b038f69a2b4586be8f5a722 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

### What looks good
- The single `OPTIONS` table in `crates/ui/src/cli_options.rs` defines `--no-activate` and `--minimized`. Both `parse` and `help_text` read this table, and `docs/user-guide/start-options.md` lists both options.
- `--minimized` sets `no_activate` too. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/shell_window/start.rs` keeps the window creation attributes and show logic small and has a clean provenance comment.
- The minimized-window crash fix protects both layers: `viewport_after_layout` keeps the previous viewport size when `window.inner_size()` has zero area, and `fit_target` clamps the texture extent with `limit_extent` to `device.limits().max_texture_dimension_2d`.
- Both `#[cfg(not(target_arch = "wasm32"))]` and `#[cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")]` arms of `run_windowed` match the new `StartMode` argument.
- Decisions are recorded in `docs/decisions/3582-start-flags.md`. The body has a `Changelog:` line and ends with `Fixes #3582`.
- No UI panels, widgets, layout, or snapshot PNGs changed.

### Results merged with main
Ran locally on Linux in `.claude/worktrees/review-3584`, trial-merged cleanly with `upstream/main` (`b5ef7c3`):
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 10 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled
  - `ui build (--no-run)`: ok
  - `ui suites: lib`: 1487 passed, 0 failed, 8 ignored (all 9 tests named in the PR body passed)
  - `ui suites: boundary`: 3 passed, 0 failed
  - `ui suites: boundary_picks`: 7 passed, 0 failed
  - `ui suites: contour_dxf_sketch`: 2 passed, 0 failed
  - `ui suites: sinker_setup`: 2 passed, 0 failed
  - `ui suites: tap_hand`: 3 passed, 0 failed
  - `ui suites: theme_example`: 3 passed, 0 failed
  - `ui suites: theme_files`: 17 passed, 0 failed
  - `ui suites: waterjet_tool`: 1 passed, 0 failed
- `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main --dry-run`: 0 steps (the diff reaches no heavy lane)
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: ok (0 warnings)

#### Extra suites run
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --test egui_app`: 8 passed, 0 failed
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --test shell`: 21 passed, 0 failed

### Requested before merge
None.

### Questions / notes (not blocking)
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/view_pass.rs:59-62`: The doc comment on `limit_extent` says "Never zero". Using `want.0.clamp(1, max_side)` would also prevent a zero output if a future caller passes a zero side directly. Current callers (`target_extent` and `View3D::resize`) already clamp to 1.
- `crates/ui/src/cli_options.rs`: Line endings changed from CRLF to LF across the file. Ignoring whitespace, the file diff is 40 insertions and 1 deletion.
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/shell_window.rs` (405 lines) and `crates/ui/src/egui_app/shell_window/frame.rs` (429 lines) sit slightly above the 400-line guideline.
- The PR title uses `feat(ui):` while issue #3582 carries the `bug` and `P3` labels. The maintainer decides whether to merge now or at the next minor cut.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
